description: Clock pair: a gate called Alpha and a copy of it called Beta, shifted from it by anything up to a whole cycle, with a combined output as well

params.text: Sets the rate of both gates, 15 BPM at the bottom of its travel and 960 BPM at the top
Sets how far Beta is shifted from Alpha, 0 degrees at the bottom of its travel, 180 degrees at the middle and 360 degrees at the top
Sets how much of each cycle both gates stay high, from 1 per cent to 99 per cent

inputs.text: Every volt doubles the rate of both gates
Shifts Beta by 36 degrees per volt, a tenth of the knob's range

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate whenever Alpha or Beta is high
Carries a 10V gate at the rate set by Alpha Rate
Carries a 10V gate at the same rate as Alpha, delayed by the amount set by Beta Shift
